question: On the shipped 0.15.0 build, with six fresh worlds, does raising the Layer-1 cap from 40 to 112 put every measured rank-21-40 present transition into service, with B1-B8 passing and B5 still able to fail?

program.question: Q054
program.relationship: BAND-1 named Q4's 62 rank-21-40 edges and was VOID on B5. BAND-2 fixed B5 and the rank reader but reused Q4's worlds, so it could not test a fresh-world band. BAND-3 keeps the fixed parser and the corrected floor, re-derives the band in six unused worlds, and leaves the cap-live gate able to fail. BAND-1 remains VOID and BAND-2 remains unrun and is not re-read as this block's evidence.

hypothesis: In each fresh world, every present transition at rank 21-40 is served at cap 112 and none of them is served at cap 40; the 112 arm has at least 56 transitions and a maximum served transition rank above 40.

design.observer: the repaired observer of PRESENCE-CONVERSION-2, returning the engine's own served list and recording the pre-cap universe with a second call
design.world: the compositional world family of PHASE_ACQUISITION at 120 cycles on six fresh seeds; no Q4 world is reused
design.pairing: each seed contributes one world and one stimulus to both caps; only the cap changes, and each band edge is paired across the two cells
design.freshness: All six seeds are fresh and unused at freeze time: seed_collisions over every docs JSON returns no hit. The record and page are the only allowed artifacts that name them.
design.reuse: No Q4 seed, no named Q4 band and no BAND-1 or BAND-2 cell is reused. This is a fresh-world generalisation of the rank rule, not a replication of the 62 named edges.

band.definition: For each seed, the band is every present transition whose minimum block rank in the cap-112 ceiling universe is 21-40. The band is measured from the 112 arm; it is not fixed to 62 edges and it is not filtered by cap-40 service.
band.derivation: Read the cap-112 cell's present_edges and universe; keep each edge whose relation is transition and whose minimum recorded rank is 21-40. A missing rank is a failure, not a zero.
band.size: measured per seed; no fixed total
band.zero_band: A seed with zero rank-21-40 present transitions is a zero denominator: B6 fails and the block is VOID, never split as 0 served.
band.service_separation: Band membership is independent of cap-40 service and is not filtered by cap-40 service. B4 measures whether the 40 arm served a band edge; it is not removed from the band to make B4 pass.

engine.treatment: only SleepService.MAX_PREDICTIONS is set per cell

endpoints.definition: world edges generated for the seed
world edges present in the temporal graph
present transitions at minimum block rank 21-40 in the 112 ceiling
band edges served in at least one cap-40 cycle
band edges served in at least one cap-112 cycle
band edges asserted at the end of the cap-112 run
per edge: rank at each cap, cycles served, first served cycle, asserted, relation

gates.B1_build: all twelve cells run the shipped 0.15.0 build at the named cap, with one sha256 across the run and only MAX_PREDICTIONS overridden; a mixed or edited build is VOID
gates.B2_world_fresh: each seed's world digest and present fingerprint are identical at 40 and 112, and every seed is absent from every prior docs artifact; a different world or a reused seed is VOID
gates.B3_band_identity: at cap 112 every band edge is a present transition whose minimum recorded rank is 21-40 and whose rank is present; each seed's band is non-empty; a missing edge, duplicate, missing rank or out-of-band rank fails B3. The band is read before cap-40 service is considered.
gates.B4_control_40: the 40 arm serves exactly 20 transitions and 0 band edges on every seed; a band edge served at 40, or a transition count other than 20, fails B4
gates.B5_cap_live: the 112 arm has at least 56 transitions, a maximum served transition rank above block rank 40, no window above 112 rows, every served edge parsed as exactly one source>target, and every served transition ranked. A fixture with 20 transitions, or with 56 transitions but a maximum served rank of 40, must fail B5; B5 is not conditional on band service. A short count, a rank ceiling at or below 40, an overfull window, an unparseable edge or an unranked served transition is VOID.
gates.B6_denominator: each seed's band is non-empty and every band edge reaches the ledger; a zero band or a zero P is not measurable and is VOID, never 0.0
gates.B7_determinism: a fresh-process rerun of seed 20612401 at 112 reproduces its per-edge ledger exactly
gates.B8_seed_axis: the six 112 ledgers hold at least three distinct served-band edge sets; a repeated set is one world, not six. Distinct served counts are not required because fresh band sizes may differ.

b5_fixture.fail_max_rank: 56 transitions with maximum served transition rank 40
b5_fixture.fail_rank_read: a served transition with no recorded rank, or an unparseable edge
b5_fixture.rule: the same b5_cap_live helper is used by the arm and by the check; the fixture must show both pass and fail

acceptance.quote: The 21–40 transitions must be served at 112 and the block's own gates must pass, per seed, with the seed axis live.
acceptance.owner: The condition is the decision's, unchanged; this block adjudicates whether it holds and does not decide what follows.

prediction.statement: Every measured band edge is served at 112 on every seed and none at 40; B5 passes with at least 56 transitions and a maximum served transition rank above 40.
prediction.because: The 112 floor is 56 and the band is ranks 21-40 by construction. BAND-1 observed 62/62 served at 112 on its Q4 worlds; this is a fresh-world generalisation, not a discovery.
prediction.prior_observation: BAND-1's band was served 62/62 at 112 and 0/62 at 40, but BAND-1 is VOID on its B5. BAND-2 corrected B5 but reused the same worlds and is unrun. Neither is BAND-3's evidence.
prediction.falsifier: Any band edge unserved at 112, any band edge served at 40, any B5 failure, an empty band, a rank mismatch, an unparseable edge, or a missing rank.
prediction.note: A pass is fresh-world service for one world family and build; it is not a capability, retention or transfer claim.

decision_table.condition: any gate other than B3 fails
decision_table.reading: the block is unrun or non-reproducible and the failed gate names what did not happen
decision_table.decision: record VOID; fix the failed gate and register a new block; read no acceptance

decision_table.condition: B3 fails: a band edge is missing, duplicate, unranked, or not ranked 21-40
decision_table.reading: the rank-21-40 band is not reproduced on the fresh build, so the band is build-dependent
decision_table.decision: report the build dependence; the acceptance stays unadjudicated; do not substitute a fresh band

decision_table.condition: gates pass; every measured band edge served at 112 on every seed
decision_table.reading: the condition is met on every measured fresh-world band edge
decision_table.decision: record the condition met; the allocation explanation is not refuted at this world family; the owner decides any engine or promotion step; no capability claim

decision_table.condition: gates pass; between 1 and all-but-one measured band edges served at 112
decision_table.reading: the condition is not met; the unserved edges are the finding and are named in the ledger
decision_table.decision: report the per-edge misses; the allocation explanation is refuted for them; the next step is the admission rule, not another level

decision_table.condition: gates pass; none of the measured band edges served at 112
decision_table.reading: the condition is not met on any measured band edge
decision_table.decision: record the refutation; the next step is the admission rule, not another level

authorisation.quote: Preregister a repaired band block with fresh seeds and the fixed harness, with B5 still able to fail, and record its grant before running.
authorisation.note: Granted 2026-11-11 against this record before any cell. The twelve design cells, the determinism rerun and the result artifact/page are authorised. The arm is not built and no cell has run; building the arm does not open a cell without a passing preflight.

runner.why: the record and grant precede the arm; no arm module exists and no cell has run

cost.wall_clock_estimate: twelve cells plus one rerun at 120 cycles each

stop_condition: No cell runs until the arm exists and its preflight passes. After that, the block closes when the twelve cells and rerun have produced their parts, B1-B8 have been scored once in the frozen order, and the verdict is recorded. A gate failure is VOID; no cell is rerun to escape a gate and no gate is amended after a result.
not_evidence: A preregistration and a grant, not a result. No cell has run. BAND-1 stays VOID and BAND-2 stays unrun; neither is re-read. This record licenses no capability, retention or transfer claim.

amendments.note: The grant was recorded before an arm was built or a cell opened; at this date the record is FROZEN, NOT RUN with cells_run = 0.
